d: India has approved ₹2.2 lakh crore ($22 billion) in defence acquisitions, including kamikaze drones, air-defence systems, howitzers, helicopters and naval destroyers to prepare for future wars. Meanwhile, Arunachal Pradesh’s proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project, designed partly to counter China’s upstream dam ambitions, has sparked fierce protests by the indigenous Adi community over fears of displacement, lost ancestral lands and threats to their way of life. As India strengthens its military and water security, both initiatives face challenges over how the country balances…
